info.name: AI Analyzer
info.description:
Every endpoint of the AI Log Analyzer project. Reference: docs/API.md. Fault behaviour: docs/FAULTS.md.

Import the "AI Analyzer - Local" environment too, or rely on the collection variable defaults. Start the services with `npm run dev:services` and traffic with `npm run traffic -- --rps 10`.

Generated by scripts/build-postman.cjs; edit that file, not this one.

request.description: Creates an order and charges it. Saves orderId and paymentId for the GET requests.
USD orders keep working during the bad_deploy fault.

exec: pm.test('status is 201 or 402 or 500 or 502 or 503 or 504', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 402, 500, 502, 503, 504]));

item.name: Faults: admin
item.description: Fault changes go to the service stderr only, never to the log stream.

item.name: Scenario 1: DB pool exhaustion
item.description: Connections leak, the pool drains, and requests fail after 2 s with 503 db_unavailable. Run traffic while it is on.

item.name: Scenario 2: Gateway timeout
item.description: Half of all charges take 3 s; payment-service gives up at 2 s and retries.

item.name: Scenario 3: Bad deploy
item.description: payment-service 1.5.0 reads a currency table missing EUR, INR and JPY, which throws a real TypeError for those orders.

item.name: Scenario 4: Memory leak
item.description: The audit cache stops evicting. Watch for "heap usage high" warnings from the process monitor every 15 s.

item.name: Scenario 5: Retry storm
item.description: Immediate retries multiply gateway load. Add bursts: npm run traffic -- --rps 10 --burst-every 20 --burst-rps 60

item.name: Platform: ingestion
item.description: Services send here automatically when LOG_INGEST_URL is set.

request.description: Body matches packages/shared/src/log-schema.ts. Searchable about 1 s later.

item.name: Ingest the same event twice (stored once)

request.description: Idempotency: both copies are accepted, the worker stores the event once.

item.name: Ingest a batch with one invalid record (goes to DLQ)

request.description: accepted 1, rejected 1; the bad record is parked in the logs.dlq topic.
Saves the first traceId for the trace view.

item.name: Platform: deploys and incidents
item.description: Incidents open automatically: run traffic, wait 5 minutes for a baseline, then run Scenario 3 (bad deploy).

request.description: 409 if the incident is already resolved.

item.name: Platform: investigations and knowledge
item.description: Investigations run automatically 30 s after detection: LLM when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, rule-based playbook otherwise.

request.description: Runs in the background; poll the investigations list.

item.name: Scenario 6: Slow queries
item.description: Every payments-db query 25x slower; payment-service logs slow queries and latency rises.

item.name: Scenario 7: Order bad deploy
item.description: order-service 2.2.0 reads a discount table missing SKU-WEBCAM: TypeError for orders containing it.

item.name: Scenario 8: Decline spike (control)
item.description: 30% of cards declined (402). A business event: no incident should open.
